British Airways pilot reports UFO flying dangerously close to New York-bound flight.

Brendan McGilligan

|

Published: Nov 4, 2026 04:45 pm

Reports of UFOs always excite the public, but as modern technology has improved, claims of seeing unknown aircraft have decreased over the decades. Now, it has emerged that in the summer of 2026, there was a new report of a UFO sighting. This time, a British Airways pilot reported it while flying 250 passengers from London to New York City. The pilot said the mysterious object nearly crashed into the plane at 5,800 feet on June 24 over Guildford, England.

The pilot contacted air traffic control after what was described as a shiny silver object, describing it as about the size of four toasters, as reported by GB News. It was reported that the UFO was flying in the opposite direction, with it coming very close to the right wing of the aircraft. The British Airways flight landed safely in the United States, in New York. However, it would have been a shocking moment for all those who noticed the UFO that day.

Details of the incident were only made public recently after an investigation by the UK Airprox Board. Yet, that report still does not say what the pilot encountered. At first, the pilots thought it was a drone. However, according to the official report, the object moved at a very high speed and had a metallic and reflective surface. Investigators later reviewed radar data from the incident but couldn’t find anything matching the object. They also couldn’t determine exactly what it was.

Another unexplained recent UFO sighting

Earlier this year, it was reported that two pilots flying over Ohio photographed a strange pill-shaped UFO that they couldn’t identify. They told their story to the National UFO Reporting Center (NUFORC). This is an organization not associated with the United States government. In their report, they detailed how they were flying a private jet above Ohio and about to enter a thunderstorm when they saw the UFO. They claimed it seemed to appear from the storm clouds ahead of them.

The UFO appeared to be heading towards the aircraft, but it ended up on their left, and they flew within two miles of the craft. This all happened at an altitude of 41,000ft. Similarly to the British Airways flight, there was an investigation into the incident. This brought about the same result. The investigation brought no satisfactory answer, as this incident remains a mystery.

NUFORC said that the flying object wasn’t detected by FAA radar or picked up on the aircraft’s traffic collision avoidance system. So, it could have just been a balloon that ended up being spotted by two pilots in a storm. However, the NUFORC couldn’t find information on corresponding balloon launches or any alert to the FAA, which is supposed to happen in such an event.
